t: You're looking at 1a Palace Gate, a house on Palace Gate in Kensington. It is Grade II* listed, a high level of protection that marks it out as a building of special interest. The house was designed by Charles John Harold Cooper, an English architect who worked in London in the nineteenth century. He lived from 1862 to 1909. The records say little more about the house than that, so the best thing to do here is look at the building itself and remember that it is Cooper's work.
